N1_ARCS.name: Kira Venn
N1_ARCS.title: The Weight of Warning
N1_ARCS.talk: Kira keeps a second watch over the docking ring. She asks whether a warning is still useful when no one wants to hear it.
N1_ARCS.brief: Kira marks a route through the service gantries. She asks you to trust the map she made by hand.
N1_ARCS.resolution: Kira has watched the gates for three nights. She asks whether to lead the next watch or finally sleep.

N1_ARCS.name: Tor Saalen
N1_ARCS.title: A Mercy Remembered
N1_ARCS.talk: Tor checks the treatment cells after lights out. He wants to know who will protect a prisoner when the guns fall silent.
N1_ARCS.brief: Tor spots a wounded attacker by the east bulkhead. He asks for a corridor to bring them in alive.
N1_ARCS.resolution: Tor has kept a list of the wounded on both sides. He asks whether to take responsibility for their care.

N1_ARCS.name: Sgt. Rhal Dax
N1_ARCS.title: The Empty Chair
N1_ARCS.talk: Rhal sets an extra place in the mess. He says a squad needs room for whoever comes home late.
N1_ARCS.brief: Rhal points to a service lift he secured before dawn. He asks you to move the squad through it.
N1_ARCS.resolution: Rhal has trained a replacement for every post. He asks whether to stay on the line or teach the next watch.

N1_ARCS.name: Ilsa Myr
N1_ARCS.title: Names in the Static
N1_ARCS.talk: Ilsa listens to old comms after the Temple sleeps. She has found a voice she knows in an enemy transmission.
N1_ARCS.brief: Ilsa traces the voice to a relay beneath the street. She asks for a quiet approach.
N1_ARCS.resolution: Ilsa has the source file and a name. She asks whether to put it before the Council.

N1_ARCS.name: Doc Bren
N1_ARCS.title: The Open Door
N1_ARCS.talk: Bren has moved a cot into the corridor. He says a locked infirmary helps no one outside it.
N1_ARCS.brief: Bren spots an unused medical store near the objective. He asks for a minute to collect it.
N1_ARCS.resolution: Bren has treated everyone who reached his door. He asks whether the ward should remain open after the siege.

N1_ARCS.name: Grak Ordo
N1_ARCS.title: The Oath at the Gate
N1_ARCS.talk: Grak polishes a cracked plate of armor. He says the clan gave it to him when he chose to guard this gate.
N1_ARCS.brief: Grak identifies a clan mark on a supply crate. He asks to challenge its bearer openly.
N1_ARCS.resolution: Grak has an offer to return home. He asks whether his watch here is finished.
